text: Want to know which font Stripe actually uses? This free site shows you. It's called Hoverstate, and every entry is a real, live website, not a Dribbble mockup. Open the Fonts tab and it lists the main typeface behind each homepage. Stripe runs on Söhne. Mercury uses Tiempos Headline. Cal dot com drew its own, Cal Sans. Tap a font and you see every site using it. And yes, Inter still leads the list. There's also a wall of open graph images, the link previews people actually click, plus a directory of design tools and Claude Code skills. Bookmark it before your next landing page, and subscribe for next Wednesday's find.
